{{Quote|Doesn't get more secure than the ''Spike''.''"<br/>"''The "''Spike''"?''"<br/>"''Underground prison facility built during the Clone Wars out by the edge of Aparian Wastes. Built to hold Jedi, if necessary.|Arkos Sovrit and Jahan Cross|<ref name="AotE – HT3" />}}
The '''Spike''' was an underground [[Prison/Legends|prison]] located in the [[Aparian Wastes/Legends|Aparian Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. The facility was built during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was designed to be able to hold captive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Description==
{{Quote|There's a perimeter barrier and security checkpoints, as well as barracks and other buildings up top.|Alessi Quon|<ref name="AotE – HT3" />}}
Primarily made from [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] and [[Ferrocrete/Legends|ferrocrete]], The Spike was an underground [[Prison/Legends|prison]] installation located along the edge of the [[Aparian Wastes/Legends|Aparian Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]<ref name="AotE – HT3" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The rooftop contained [[Power fence/Legends|perimiter barrier]] and security checkpoints, as well as barracks and other buildings. The top floors contained infrastructure, [[Comm unit/Legends|comms]], and [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]. The next floors were for the [[Serenno security forces|security personnel]], who were a mixture of [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] and [[Droid/Legends|droids]]; they included comissary, recreation, and changing rooms. Below that was the [[The Spike's command and control floor|command and control floor]], where everything was monitored and where [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] from the top floor ended. Next, under the control floor were at least six levels of prisoners' cells that were only accessible with stairs. At the very bottom of the installation was [[The Point (The Spike)|The Point]], a place with a single cell where the most important prisoners were held.<ref name="AotE – HT3" />

==History==
{{Quote|I need some info. There is a prison on Serenno called the ''Spike''. The Empire will have specs and schematics on file somewhere. I need them.|Jahan Cross|<ref name="AotE – HT3" />}}
The Spike was built as a place to hold captured [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In about [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Aveca Dunn]] was incarcerated in The Spike when she was captured by [[Serenno Spaceport Security]] after attempting to kidnap [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Bron Dooku]]. However, the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jahan Cross]]&mdash;a former lover of Dunn&mdash;subsequently [[Infiltration of The Spike|infiltrated]] the prison in an attempt to rescue her. After shutting off the power to the facility, so as to release all of the prisoners from their cells and thereby create a diversion, Cross and Dunn were able to escape the prison by masquerading as guards.<ref name="AotE – HT3" /> In the aftermath of the incident, [[Gundren]] was removed from his position as [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] of The Spike, and then, he returned home and [[Death/Legends|killed himself]] rather than face investigation and possible charges.<ref name="AotE – HT4">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 4|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 4]]</ref>
